name: Technology Task Force Meeting
minutes_text:
August 24, 2017

  ACTION MEMO
  OF THE
  TECHNOLOGY TASK FORCE
  OF THE
  CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

CALL TO ORDER

Committee Members Chairman Wagman, Jue, Juelle, Myers, and Peckovich.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Technology Task Force on
matters presented under this section.

  Comments from David Hall on municipal internet service and Ghazala Khan on
  connectivity.

NEW BUSINESS

1. Development of a Recommendation for Technology Committee Composition

  Consensus from members of Technology Task Force to develop recommendations and
  present them at the September 14, 2017 meeting.

2. Discussion of potential topics for scope of a Technology Committee, including Wireless
  Telecom Facilities Review and Approval and Broadband Infrastructure Master Plan

  Discussed wireless telecommunications, Technology Master Plan, and technology for
  internal operations. Consensus from members of Technology Task Force to develop
  recommendations and present them at the September 14, 2017 meeting.

3. Scheduling of Future Meetings and Agendas

  Consensus on scheduling the Technology Task Force to meet on Wednesday, September
  14, 2017 at 3:30 p.m. and Wednesday, October 19, 2017 at 3:30 p.m.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATION

The following items of correspondence are submitted to the Technology Task Force for
information.
  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 12, 2017.
 4. None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE

5. Staff Items of Information for the Committee.

  None

ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2017, 3:30 P.M. IN COUNCIL
CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL.

i. This Technology Task Force meeting was audio-recorded and can be accessed thereafter on the
City Website at www.pvestates.org.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 12, 2017.
